name: Good Sense
overview: Scripture highlights that good sense, or understanding, brings favor and smooths the way of the believer, contrasting sharply with the difficulties faced by transgressors as seen in Proverbs 13:15. Jesus' departure from the temple in Matthew 24:1 reminds us to focus on eternal truths beyond earthly structures, pointing us toward the ultimate expression of God's wisdom and love. This is powerfully demonstrated in John 3:16, where God's provision of His Son offers everlasting life to all who believe, revealing that true good sense involves trusting in God's redemptive plan.
